the report also discusses knowledge-management needs, limited nuclear education and pandemic-related training adjustments.","notes":["The excerpt supports 1,400 permanent CFE Nuclear Corporate Coordination employees, not an undifferentiated 1,400-person nuclear workforce.","It does not expressly state historical loss of experienced personnel or reduced technical training during the pandemic; it describes knowledge-management concerns, limited nuclear-sector educational supply, and rescheduled tests and training relief."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0002-E009","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0002-E010","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0002-E011","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"By the report period, CFE had implemented or developed multiple Laguna Verde mitigation measures, including spent-fuel-pool instrumentation and hardened-venting measures; FLEX Phase 3 remained in development, a conclusion report for certain measures was pending, and CNSNS held quarterly meetings with CFE to verify program compliance.","notes":["The excerpt states that spent-fuel-pool instrumentation construction was completed, but it does not independently establish full operational completion of every instrumentation measure.","The excerpt describes authorization and implementation of hardened-venting modification packages, but does not itself state that all hardened-venting work was completed."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0002-E012","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0002-E013","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]}]}
